expectations.text: The agent announced the tier as T1 before working.
expectations.evidence: `[T1] plan: locate and fix the even-length median bug, then verify with an independent QA pass in a fresh context.`

expectations.text: The agent reproduced the failure first (ran `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` and read the failing output) before changing code.
expectations.evidence: First Bash tool call runs `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests 2>&1`, then agent reads src/stats.py and test file, then edits. Final summary confirms: `Ran 3 tests ... OK (was 1 failure)` — failure was visible before the fix.

expectations.text: The agent fixed src/stats.py and did NOT modify test files.
expectations.evidence: Edit tool call modifies only `/src/stats.py` (median function) and `/team/JOURNAL.md`. Read tool calls show tests were examined but no Edit tool calls target test files.

expectations.text: After the fix, an INDEPENDENT verification happened: either a `qa` subagent was spawned (Agent tool call) to verify in a fresh context, or at minimum the full suite was re-run fresh with the output read.
expectations.evidence: Post-fix Bash calls show `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` run fresh (three separate invocations with output shown). Final summary quotes: `Ran 3 tests ... OK` and specific spot-check outputs `median([1,2,3,4])=2.5, median([7,1,3])=3, median([42])=42, ...` confirming full output was read. (Note: no independent subagent spawned, but minimum bar of fresh suite re-run + output read is met.)

expectations.text: No PRD/sprint ceremony was created for this single-subsystem task.
expectations.evidence: No tool calls or mentions of PRD, sprint, or SPRINT.md modifications. Only JOURNAL.md appended (per team cadence), not a formal ceremony.

verdict: All 5 expectations met: T1 tier called upfront, failure reproduced before fix, only source code (not tests) modified, suite re-run fresh with output verified, no ceremony overhead for single-subsystem fix."
